checks: The immutable capability parser and its dependency descriptor are pinned, including the executed capability and reviewed main-v2 dependency chain. BASIC rows must occur after the CAP event header and before CAP worker parking.

Exact emitter fields, multiplicity, order, newline termination, 255-byte row bound and numeric widths are enforced. Unknown, truncated, interleaved, oversized and invalid UTF-8 input refuses completion. Both outcomes require captured owner state without halt and a closed lease.

Success requires CID2, sequence 5, 76 bytes, TX index 4 to 5, DIDX 5, a supported DDONE/writeback pair, one publication, bounded polling and debug rearming, completed 5, and explicit zero firmware ACK fields. Network and scan readiness remain false.

TC4 accounting requires supported version 0x80000001, positive PSE command quota, debit 1 PSE and 0 PLE, one reservation, and remaining quota minus one. Page sizes and extra count remain bounded metadata.

Clean skips are separate from transfers and require no callbacks, publication, debit, rearming, halt or command completion. Reasons 1 and 2 require zero predecoded capability/resource metadata. Reason 3 requires a refused resource prerequisite and zero budget. The currently unreachable fixed-builder reason 4 is refused.

Redecoded known/unknown counts and resource version/support correlate with captured CAP TLV metadata. Optional SKU/PHY metadata absence cannot gate CID2. BASIC contains no MAC field and does not establish MAC application.

Last-debug metadata requires the supported outer mask, inner E000, EID27, ASCII type 3, owned extent 48..3840, bounded debug length, raw-header correlation and the last consumed ring index. Declared lengths and sequence remain metadata under the existing source policy.
An independent real-owner fixture emitted debug index 4 after one CAP and one debug event, validating the parser formula. The initial provisional off-by-one concern was withdrawn.
limitations: No actual BASIC hardware receipt exists. Positive cases are synthetic continuations embedded in the SHA-pinned successful CAP capture.

The unlogged capability body prevents independent replay of resource quotas and SKU/PHY values. The parser cannot prove callback history; it depends on reviewed and pinned native emitters and ownership checks.
A complete clean skip is a coherent parked observation, not a command transfer. DDONE proves neither firmware ACK, MAC application, regulatory readiness nor network usability.
Only the last debug header and metadata are captured. Prior accepted debug bodies are not replayed. No MAC, calibration bytes, debug body or network identifiers are returned.
scope: Only independent-parser-review.json added. No source/gates/image/git/CI/device changes.
